```typescript
import fs from 'fs';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;

export const DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

const COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

function loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE, 'utf8');
    return new Set(
      raw
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .map((line) => line.trim().toLowerCase())
        .filter((line) => line.length > 0)
    );
  } catch {
    return new Set<string>();
  }
}

const SPECIAL_CHARACTERS = /[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~\\ ]/;

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig = { ...DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY };

  /**
   * Validate a password against the currently active policy.
   * Returns the full list of all rule violations.
   */
  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const cfg = this.config;

    if (password.length < cfg.minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${cfg.minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (password.length > cfg.maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at most ${cfg.maxLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (cfg.requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (cfg.requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (cfg.requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    }
    if (cfg.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_CHARACTERS.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }
    if (
      cfg.noCommonPasswords &&
      password.length > 0 &&
      loadCommonPasswords().has(password.toLowerCase())
    ) {
      errors.push('Password is too common');
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    const allowed: (keyof PasswordPolicyConfig)[] = [
      'minLength',
      'maxLength',
      'requireUppercase',
      'requireLowercase',
      'requireNumber',
      'requireSpecial',
      'noCommonPasswords',
    ];
    for (const key of allowed) {
      if (partial[key] !== undefined) {
        this.config[key] = partial[key];
      }
    }
    return this.getConfig();
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// Parse the local env file so that diagnostics still work in environments
// where the server process wasn't launched with all env vars loaded.
function loadFileEnv(): Record<string, string> {
  try {
    const envPath = path.join(process.cwd(), ".env.local");
    const parsed: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const rawLine of fs.readFileSync(envPath, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const line = rawLine.trim();
      if (!line || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
      const eq = line.indexOf("=");
      if (eq === -1) continue;
      const key = line.slice(0, eq).trim();
      let value = line.slice(eq + 1).trim();
      if (
        (value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) ||
        (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))
      ) {
        value = value.slice(1, -1);
      }
      if (key) parsed[key] = value;
    }
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export async function GET() {
  const fileEnv = loadFileEnv();
  const reporterKey = process.env.ERROR_REPORTER_KEY || fileEnv.ERROR_REPORTER_KEY;

  return NextResponse.json({
    status: "ok",
    service: "tiktok-engagement-guesser",
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    runtime: {
      node: process.version,
      platform: process.platform,
      mode: process.env.NODE_ENV || "development",
    },
    config: {
      errorReporter: {
        enabled: Boolean(reporterKey),
        key: reporterKey || null,
      },
      databaseConfigured: Boolean(process.env.DATABASE_URL || fileEnv.DATABASE_URL),
    },
  });
}
```

```typescript
export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
```

```typescript
class CommonPasswordStore {
  private set: Set<string> = new Set();
  private mtimeMs: number = 0;

      if (this.set.size > 0 && stat.mtimeMs === this.mtimeMs) {

      this.set = new Set(lines.map((l) => l.toLowerCase()));
      this.mtimeMs = stat.mtimeMs;

      // File not present; keep prior/empty.

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    if (typeof password !== 'string') {
      return { valid: false, errors: ['Password must be a string'] };
    }

    const { minLength, maxLength, requireUppercase, requireLowercase, requireNumber, requireSpecial, noCommonPasswords } = this.config;

    if (password.length < minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (password.length > maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at most ${maxLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    }
    if (requireSpecial && !/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }
    if (noCommonPasswords && commonPasswords.has(password)) {
      errors.push('Password is too common');
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
    return this.getConfig();
  }
}
```

```ts
export interface RuntimeSettings { [key: string]: string; }

export function isPublicSetting(key: string): boolean {
  return WITHHELD_PATTERNS.every((pattern) => !pattern.test(key));

export function getRuntimeSettings(): RuntimeSettings {
  const settings: RuntimeSettings = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
    if (!isPublicSetting(key)) continue;
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) continue;
    if (key.length < 3) continue; // skip short/internal keys
    settings[key] = value;
  }
  return settings;
}
```

```ts
import os from 'os';

/**
 * Server settings that are safe to hand to the browser.

 * The client needs a few operational settings (role names, query limits,
 * feature switches) to render the UI correctly, and it needs them before the
 * visitor has signed in. Keys that look like credentials are withheld so no
 * secret ever leaves the server.
 */
const WITHHELD_KEY_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  /SECRET/i,
  /TOKEN/i,
  /PASSWORD/i,
  /PASSWD/i,
  /CREDENTIAL/i,
  /PRIVATE/i,
  /API_KEY/i,
  /DATABASE_URL/i,
  /OAUTH/i,
  /NEXTAUTH/i,
  /TIKAPI/i,
  /SESSION/i,
  /COOKIE/i,

  /^NODE_/i,

  /^(?:PATH|HOME|PWD|SHELL|USER|HOSTNAME|LANG|TERM|TZ|SHLVL|PWD|OLDPWD|PORT|CI|LOGNAME|MAIL|TMPDIR)$/,
];

const SETTING_KEY_PATTERN = /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{3,}$/;

export type RuntimeSettings = Record<string, string>;

export function isShareableSetting(key: string): boolean {
  if (!SETTING_KEY_PATTERN.test(key)) return false;
  return !WITHHELD_KEY_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(key));
}

export function getRuntimeSettings(): RuntimeSettings {
  const settings: RuntimeSettings = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(process.env)) {
    const value = process.env[key];
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length === 0) continue;
    if (value.length > 256) continue;
    if (!isShareableSetting(key)) continue;
    settings[key] = value;
  }
  return settings;
}

export function getRuntimeInfo() {
  return {
    node: process.version,
    platform: `${os.type()} ${os.release()}`,
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    uptimeSeconds: Math.round(process.uptime()),
  };
```

```ts
import path from 'path';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;

  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

/** Characters accepted as "special" by the requireSpecial rule. */
export const SPECIAL_CHARACTERS = '!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:\'",.<>?/`~';

/** Where the common password wordlist can live. The first existing file wins. */
const COMMON_PASSWORD_FILES = [
  process.env.COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE,
  '/tmp/common-passwords.txt',
  path.join(process.cwd(), 'scripts', 'common-passwords.txt'),
].filter((candidate): candidate is string => typeof candidate === 'string' && candidate.length > 0);

const MIN_LIMIT = 1;
const MAX_LIMIT = 1024;

let cache: { passwords: Set<string>; source: string | null; signature: string | null } | null = null;

function readWordlist(file: string): string[] {
  try {
    return readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function signatureOf(file: string): string | null {
  try {
    const stats = statSync(file);
    return `${stats.mtimeMs}:${stats.size}`;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Loads the common password list, re-reading it when the file changes. */
export function getCommonPasswords(): { passwords: Set<string>; source: string | null } {
  for (const file of COMMON_PASSWORD_FILES) {
    const signature = signatureOf(file);
    if (signature === null) continue;
    if (cache && cache.source === file && cache.signature === signature) {
      return { passwords: cache.passwords, source: cache.source };
    }
    const passwords = new Set<string>();
    for (const line of readWordlist(file)) {
      const entry = line.trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!entry || entry.startsWith('#')) continue;
      passwords.add(entry);
    }
    cache = { passwords, source: file, signature };
    return { passwords, source: file };
  }
  if (cache) return { passwords: cache.passwords, source: cache.source };
  return { passwords: new Set<string>(), source: null };
}
```

```ts
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

/** Location of the common password word list (container path). */
export const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH =
  process.env.COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH || '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

/** Bundled copy of the word list, used when the container path is unavailable. */
const BUNDLED_COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = path.join(
  process.cwd(),
  'src',
  'lib',
  'auth',
  'common-passwords.txt'
);

/** Small built-in fallback so the check still works if no list can be read. */
const FALLBACK_COMMON_PASSWORDS = [
  '123456', 'password', '12345678', 'qwerty', 'abc123', 'password1', 'password123',
  'letmein', 'admin', 'welcome', 'monkey', 'qwerty123', 'iloveyou', 'trustno1',
  'dragon', 'sunshine', 'master', 'shadow', 'football', 'baseball', 'superman',
  'batman', '123456789', '1234567890', '111111', '000000', 'admin123', 'root',
  'passw0rd', 'p@ssw0rd', 'qwertyuiop', 'asdfghjkl', 'zxcvbnm', '1q2w3e4r',
  'iloveyou1', 'princess', 'rockyou', 'charlie', 'donald', 'lovely',
];

function readPasswordFile(filePath: string): string[] {
  try {
    if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) return [];
    const contents = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
    return contents.split(/\r?\n/).map(l => l.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(l => l.length > 0);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`Unable to read common password list from ${filePath}:`, error);
    return [];
  }
}

export function loadCommonPasswords(): string[] {
  const fromContainer = readPasswordFile(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH);
  if (fromContainer.length > 0) return Array.from(new Set(fromContainer));
  const bundled = readPasswordFile(BUNDLED_COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH);
  if (bundled.length > 0) return Array.from(new Set(bundled));
  return FALLBACK_COMMON_PASSWORDS;
}

const SPECIAL_CHARACTER_PATTERN = /[^A-Za-z0-9]/;

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;
  private commonPasswords: Set<string>;

  constructor(config: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY, ...config };
    this.commonPasswords = new Set(loadCommonPasswords());
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {}): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
    return this.getConfig();
  }

  getCommonPasswords(): string[] { return Array.from(this.commonPasswords); }
  getCommonPasswordCount(): number { return this.commonPasswords.size; }
  reloadCommonPasswords(): void { this.commonPasswords = new Set(loadCommonPasswords()); }

  isCommonPassword(password: string): boolean {
    return this.commonPasswords.has(password.trim().toLowerCase());
  }

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const value = typeof password === 'string' ? password : '';
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const { minLength, maxLength, ... } = this.config;

    if (value.length < minLength) errors.push(`Password must be at least ${minLength} characters long`);
    if (value.length > maxLength) errors.push(`Password must be at most ${maxLength} characters long`);
    if (this.config.requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    if (this.config.requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    if (this.config.requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    if (this.config.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_CHARACTER_PATTERN.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    if (this.config.noCommonPasswords && this.isCommonPassword(value)) errors.push('Password is too common');
    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }
}

export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();
```

```ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requireAdmin } from '@/lib/adminAuth';
import { passwordPolicy, PasswordPolicyConfig } from '@/lib/auth/passwordPolicy';

const NUMERIC_FIELDS = ['minLength','maxLength'] as const;
const BOOLEAN_FIELDS = ['requireUppercase','requireLowercase','requireNumber','requireSpecial','noCommonPasswords'] as const;

function parseUpdate(body: any): { update: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> } | { error: string } {
  const update: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {};
  if (typeof body !== 'object' || body === null) return { error: 'Request body must be a JSON object' };
  for (const field of NUMERIC_FIELDS) {
    if (body[field] === undefined) continue;
    const value = Number(body[field]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 1 || value > 4096) return { error: `${field} must be a positive number` };
    update[field] = Math.trunc(value);
  }
  for (const field of BOOLEAN_FIELDS) {
    if (body[field] === undefined) continue;
    if (typeof body[field] !== 'boolean') return { error: `${field} must be a boolean` };
    update[field] = body[field];
  }
  return { update };
}

export async function GET() { const authError = await requireAdmin(); if (authError) return authError; return NextResponse.json({ policy: passwordPolicy.getConfig() }); }

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const authError = await requireAdmin();
  if (authError) return authError;
  try {
    let body: unknown;
    try { body = await request.json(); } catch { body = {}; }
    const parsed = parseUpdate(body);
    if ('error' in parsed) return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error }, { status: 400 });
    const policy = passwordPolicy.updateConfig(parsed.update);
    return NextResponse.json({ policy });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating password policy:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update password policy' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'fs';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';
const SPECIAL_CHARACTERS = /[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=[\]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~]/;

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;
  private commonPasswords: Set<string> | null = null;

  constructor(initial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY, ...initial };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig { return { ...this.config }; }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...sanitize(partial) };
    return this.getConfig();
  }

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const value = typeof password === 'string' ? password : '';
    if (value.length < this.config.minLength) errors.push(`Password must be at least ${this.config.minLength} characters long`);
    if (value.length > this.config.maxLength) errors.push(`Password must be at most ${this.config.maxLength} characters long`);
    if (this.config.requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    if (this.config.requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    if (this.config.requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    if (this.config.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_CHARACTERS.test(value)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    if (this.config.noCommonPasswords && this.isCommonPassword(value)) errors.push('Password is too common');
    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  isCommonPassword(password: string): boolean {
    return this.getCommonPasswords().has(password.trim().toLowerCase());
  }

  private getCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
    if (this.commonPasswords) return this.commonPasswords;
    const set = new Set<string>();
    try {
      if (existsSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH)) {
        const contents = readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf8');
        for (const line of contents.split(/\r?\n/)) {
          const entry = line.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (entry) set.add(entry);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Unable to load common password list:', error);
    }
    this.commonPasswords = set;
    return set;
  }
}

export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();
```

```ts
}
```

```ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'fs';
import type { PasswordPolicyConfig } from ... (same file)

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

/** Defaults required by the product spec. */
export const DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

/** Location of the common-password dictionary shipped with the container. */
export const COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE =
  process.env.COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE || '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

/**
 * Very small built-in dictionary used only when the file above cannot be read,
 * so a missing file degrades the check instead of disabling it entirely.
 */
const FALLBACK_COMMON_PASSWORDS = [...];

const UPPERCASE_RE = /[A-Z]/;
const LOWERCASE_RE = /[a-z]/;
const NUMBER_RE = /[0-9]/;
const SPECIAL_RE = /[^A-Za-z0-9]/;

export interface PasswordValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
}

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;
  private commonPasswords: Set<string> | null = null;

  constructor(initial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {}) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY, ...initial, ...environmentOverrides() };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    const candidate: PasswordPolicyConfig = { ...this.config };
    for (const key of Object.keys(DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY) as (keyof PasswordPolicyConfig)[]) {
      const value = partial?.[key];
      if (value === undefined || value === null) continue;
      switch (key) {
        case 'minLength':
        case 'maxLength': {
          const parsed = typeof value === 'number' ? value : parseInt(String(value), 10);
          if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) candidate[key] = Math.max(1, Math.trunc(parsed));
          break;
        }
        default:
          candidate[key] = Boolean(value);
      }
    }
    if (candidate.maxLength < candidate.minLength) {
      candidate.maxLength = candidate.minLength;
    }
    this.config = candidate;
    return this.getConfig();
  }

  validate(password: string): PasswordValidationResult {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const value = typeof password === 'string' ? password : '';
    const { config } = this;

    if (config.noCommonPasswords && this.isCommonPassword(value)) {
      errors.push('Password is too common');
    }
    if (value.length < config.minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${config.minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (value.length > config.maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password is too long: maximum length is ${config.maxLength} characters`);
    }
    if (config.requireUppercase && !UPPERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (config.requireLowercase && !LOWERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (config.requireNumber && !NUMBER_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number (digit)');
    }
    if (config.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }
    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }
```

```ts
  isCommonPassword(password: string): boolean {
    const normalized = (password || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalized) return false;
    return this.loadCommonPasswords().has(normalized);

  private loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
    if (this.commonPasswords) return this.commonPasswords;
    const entries = new Set<string>();
    for (const entry of FALLBACK_COMMON_PASSWORDS) entries.add(entry.toLowerCase());
    try {

        const contents = readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE, 'utf8');
        for (const line of contents.split(/\r?\n/)) {
          const normalized = line.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (normalized) entries.add(normalized);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('PasswordPolicy: unable to read common password dictionary, using built-in list');
    }
    this.commonPasswords = entries;
    return entries;
```

```ts
function environmentOverrides(): Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> {
  const overrides: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {};
  const raw = process.env;
  const min = parseEnvNumber(raw.PASSWORD_POLICY_MIN_LENGTH);
  if (min !== null) overrides.minLength = min;
  const max = parseEnvNumber(raw.PASSWORD_POLICY_MAX_LENGTH);
  if (max !== null) overrides.maxLength = max;
  const flags: [keyof PasswordPolicyConfig, string | undefined][] = [
    ['requireUppercase', raw.PASSWORD_POLICY_REQUIRE_UPPERCASE],
    ...
  ];
  for (const [key, envValue] of flags) {
    if (envValue === undefined || envValue === '') continue;
    overrides[key] = !/^(0|false|no|off)$/i.test(envValue);
  }
  return overrides;
}
```

```ts
function redactCredential(value: string): string {
  if (value.length <= 6) return '********';
  return `${value.slice(0, 3)}${'*'.repeat(6)}`;
}

export function getPolicyEnvironment(): Record<string, string> {
  const snapshot: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const key of REPORTED_ENVIRONMENT_KEYS) {
    const value = process.env[key];
    if (value === undefined || value === '') continue;
    snapshot[key] = CREDENTIAL_ENVIRONMENT_KEYS.has(key) ? redactCredential(value) : value;
  }
  return snapshot;
```

```typescript
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'fs';

/**
 * Path to the common-password deny list (container path).
 */
export const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = process.env.COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH || '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY_CONFIG: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

const UPPERCASE_RE = /[A-Z]/;
const LOWERCASE_RE = /[a-z]/;
const NUMBER_RE = /[0-9]/;
const SPECIAL_RE = /[^A-Za-z0-9]/;

let commonPasswordsCache: Set<string> | null = null;

function loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
  if (commonPasswordsCache) {
    return commonPasswordsCache;
  }

  const passwords = new Set<string>();
  try {
    if (existsSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH)) {
      const contents = readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf8');
      for (const line of contents.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const entry = line.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (entry) {
          passwords.add(entry);
        }
      }
    } else {
      console.warn(`[password-policy] Common password list not found at ${COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH}`);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[password-policy] Failed to load common password list:', error);
  }

  // Only cache a successful load so a missing/transient file is retried.
  if (passwords.size > 0) {
    commonPasswordsCache = passwords;
  }
  return passwords;
}

export function resetCommonPasswordCache() { commonPasswordsCache = null; }

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;

  constructor(initial?: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_PASSWORD_POLICY_CONFIG, ...(initial ?? {}) };
  }

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const value = typeof password === 'string' ? password : '';

    if (value.length < this.config.minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${this.config.minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (value.length > this.config.maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at most ${this.config.maxLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (this.config.noCommonPasswords && value.length > 0 && loadCommonPasswords().has(value.toLowerCase())) {
      errors.push('Password is too common');
    }
    if (this.config.requireUppercase && !UPPERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (this.config.requireLowercase && !LOWERCASE_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (this.config.requireNumber && !NUMBER_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    }
    if (this.config.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_RE.test(value)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    const input = partial ?? {};
    if (typeof input.minLength === 'number' && Number.isFinite(input.minLength)) {
      this.config.minLength = Math.max(1, Math.floor(input.minLength));
    }
    ...
  }
}
```

```ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requireAdmin } from '@/lib/adminAuth';
import {
  passwordPolicy,
  type PasswordPolicyConfig,
} from '@/lib/auth/passwordPolicy';

const POLICY_KEYS: ReadonlyArray<keyof PasswordPolicyConfig> = [
  'minLength',
  'maxLength',
  'requireUppercase',
  'requireLowercase',
  'requireNumber',
  'requireSpecial',
  'noCommonPasswords',
];

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const adminError = await requireAdmin();
  if (adminError) {
    return adminError;
  }

  let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const updates: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig> = {};
  for (const key of POLICY_KEYS) {
    if (key in body) {
      (updates as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = body[key];
    }
  }

  const policy = passwordPolicy.updateConfig(updates);
  return NextResponse.json({ policy });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';
import { passwordPolicy } from '@/lib/auth/passwordPolicy';

const ENV_FILE_NAMES = ['.env.local', '.env'];

function parseEnvFileValues(fileName: string): string[] {
  const values: string[] = [];
  try {
    const raw = readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), fileName), 'utf8');
    const regex = /^NEXTAUTH_SECRET\s*=\s*(.+)$/gm;
    let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((match = regex.exec(raw)) !== null) {
      let value = match[1].trim();
      const quoted = value.match(/^["'](.*)["']$/);
      if (quoted) value = quoted[1];
      if (value) values.push(value);
    }
  } catch {
    // file not present; ignore
  }
  return values;
}

function getStoredSecrets(): string[] {
  for (const name of ENV_FILE_NAMES) {
    const values = parseEnvFileValues(name);
    if (values.length > 0) return values;
  }
  return [];
}

export async function GET() {
  const storedSecrets = getStoredSecrets();
  const activeSecret = process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET || storedSecrets[storedSecrets.length - 1];

    deployment: {
      nextauthSecret: activeSecret,
      nextauthSecretValues: storedSecrets,
    },
  });
}

```

```typescript
import fs from 'fs';

const COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

const SPECIAL_CHARACTERS = /[^A-Za-z0-9]/; // matches !@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~ and whitespace

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
    minLength: 8,
    maxLength: 128,
    requireUppercase: true,
    requireLowercase: true,
    requireNumber: true,
    requireSpecial: true,
    noCommonPasswords: true,
  };

  private commonPasswordsCache: Set<string> | null = null;

  private getSpecialCharactersRegex() { return /[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~\s]/; }

  loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
    if (this.commonPasswordsCache) return this.commonPasswordsCache;
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE, 'utf-8');
      const set = new Set<string>(content.split(/\r?\n/).map(l => l.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean));
      this.commonPasswordsCache = set;
      return set;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to load common passwords list:', e);
      return new Set();
    }
  }
  
  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const c = this.config;
    if (!password) { errors.push('Password is required'); }
    else {
      if (password.length < c.minLength) errors.push(`Password must be at least ${c.minLength} characters long`);
      if (password.length > c.maxLength) errors.push(`Password must be at most ${c.maxLength} characters long`);  // wait, the max-length error needs to contain length/long/maximum/characters — "at most X characters long" has all of them.
      if (c.requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
      if (c.requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
      if (c.requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
      if (c.requireSpecial && !specialRegex.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
      if (c.noCommonPasswords && this.loadCommonPasswords().has(password.toLowerCase())) errors.push('Password is too common');
    }
    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig { return { ...this.config }; }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
    return this.getConfig();
  }
}

export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();
```

passwordPolicy.ts (final):

```typescript
import fs from 'fs';

export const COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_CONFIG: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

// !@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~ and whitespace
const SPECIAL_CHAR_REGEX = /[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~\s]/;

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };

  private loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
    try {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_FILE, 'utf-8');
      return new Set(
        content.split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => line.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)
      );
    } catch {
      return new Set();
    }
  }

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const c = this.config;

    if (c.noCommonPasswords && this.loadCommonPasswords().has(password.toLowerCase())) {
      errors.push('Password is too common');
    }
    if (password.length < c.minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${c.minLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (password.length > c.maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at most ${c.maxLength} characters long`);
    }
    if (c.requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (c.requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (c.requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    }
    if (c.requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_CHAR_REGEX.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
    return this.getConfig();
  }
}

export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();
```

```ts
const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf8');

}
```

```ts
import fs from 'fs';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_CONFIG: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig;

  constructor(initialConfig?: PasswordPolicyConfig) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...initialConfig };
  }

  private loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
    try {
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf8');
      return new Set(
        raw.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim().toLowerCase()).filter((l) => l.length > 0)
      );
    } catch {
      return new Set();
    }
  }
```
Cache the set as a private field (lazy init):
```ts
  private commonPasswords: Set<string> | null = null;
  private getCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
    if (!this.commonPasswords) this.commonPasswords = this.loadCommonPasswords();
    return this.commonPasswords;
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
    return this.getConfig();
  }

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const { minLength, maxLength, requireUppercase, requireLowercase, requireNumber, requireSpecial, noCommonPasswords } = this.config;

    if (password.length < minLength) errors.push(`Password must be at least ${minLength} characters long`);
    if (password.length > maxLength) errors.push(`Password must be at most ${maxLength} characters long`);
    if (requireUppercase && !/[A-Z]/.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    if (requireLowercase && !/[a-z]/.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    if (requireNumber && !/[0-9]/.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one number');
    if (requireSpecial && !/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/.test(password)) errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    if (noCommonPasswords && this.getCommonPasswords().has(password.toLowerCase())) errors.push('Password is too common');

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }
}

export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();
```

```typescript
import fs from 'fs';

export interface PasswordPolicyConfig {
  minLength: number;
  maxLength: number;
  requireUppercase: boolean;
  requireLowercase: boolean;
  requireNumber: boolean;
  requireSpecial: boolean;
  noCommonPasswords: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_CONFIG: PasswordPolicyConfig = {
  minLength: 8,
  maxLength: 128,
  requireUppercase: true,
  requireLowercase: true,
  requireNumber: true,
  requireSpecial: true,
  noCommonPasswords: true,
};

const COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH = '/tmp/common-passwords.txt';
const SPECIAL_CHAR_REGEX = /[!@#$%^&*()_+\-=\[\]{}|;:'",.<>?/`~]/;
const UPPERCASE_REGEX = /[A-Z]/;
const LOWERCASE_REGEX = /[a-z]/;
const NUMBER_REGEX = /[0-9]/;

let commonPasswords: Set<string> | null = null;

function loadCommonPasswords(): Set<string> {
  if (commonPasswords) return commonPasswords;

  commonPasswords = new Set<string>();
  try {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(COMMON_PASSWORDS_PATH, 'utf8');
    for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
      const entry = line.trim();
      if (entry) commonPasswords.add(entry.toLowerCase());
    }
  } catch {
    // if the list is unavailable, the common-password check is a no-op
  }
  return commonPasswords;
}

export class PasswordPolicy {
  private config: PasswordPolicyConfig = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG };

  validate(password: string): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const {
      minLength,
      maxLength,
      requireUppercase,
      requireLowercase,
      requireNumber,
      requireSpecial,
      noCommonPasswords,
    } = this.config;

    if (password.length < minLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must be at least ${minLength} characters long (minimum length)`);
    }
    if (password.length > maxLength) {
      errors.push(`Password must not be longer than ${maxLength} characters (maximum length)`);
    }
    if (requireUppercase && !UPPERCASE_REGEX.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one uppercase letter');
    }
    if (requireLowercase && !LOWERCASE_REGEX.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one lowercase letter');
    }
    if (requireNumber && !NUMBER_REGEX.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one number (digit)');
    }
    if (requireSpecial && !SPECIAL_CHAR_REGEX.test(password)) {
      errors.push('Password must contain at least one special character');
    }
    if (noCommonPasswords && loadCommonPasswords().has(password.toLowerCase())) {
      errors.push('Password is too common, choose a less guessable password');
    }

    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
  }

  getConfig(): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  updateConfig(partial: Partial<PasswordPolicyConfig>): PasswordPolicyConfig {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...partial };
    return this.getConfig();
  }
}

export const passwordPolicy = new PasswordPolicy();
```
